name: Öz Adana Kebap

winterMessage: Sezon kapalı — Nisan'da görüşürüz! WhatsApp'tan rezervasyon alıyoruz.
tagline: Kalkan'ın en lezzetli Adana kebabı — 1292 mutlu müşteri.
notes: Kalkan merkezde, 1992'den beri hizmet veren geleneksel Adana kebap lokantası. Odun ateşinde pişirilmiş el yapımı kebaplar.

services.name: Kuzu Şiş
services.description: Taze kuzu etinden hazırlanan şiş kebabı, mangal aromasıyla.

services.name: Tavuk Şiş
services.description: Marine edilmiş tavuk göğsü, hafif baharatlı.

services.name: Karışık Tabak
services.description: Adana, Urfa ve şiş bir arada. 2 kişilik porsiyon.

services.name: Çoban Salatası
services.description: Taze domates, salatalık, biber. Günlük hazırlanır.

services.name: Humus

name: Kaptan Restaurant
winterMessage: Season closed — see you in April! Reservations via WhatsApp.
tagline: Fresh catch, mezze & sunset views on the Kaş waterfront.
notes: Kaptan Restaurant, Kaş waterfront. Signature fresh fish, mezze, grills. Blue-white Aegean aesthetic, sunset terrace, nautical character. Primary audience: British/foreign tourists, couples, families.

services.name: Kaptan Mezze Plate
services.description: A selection of our signature cold and warm mezze — tarator, smoked aubergine, stuffed vine leaves, and more.

services.name: Fresh Catch of the Day
services.description: Grilled whole fish, caught fresh each morning from the Aegean. Ask your server for today's catch.

services.name: Sea Bass in Salt Crust
services.description: Whole sea bass baked in a salt crust, served tableside. A Kaptan classic.

services.name: Lamb Chops
services.description: Tender marinated lamb chops, charcoal-grilled to perfection.

services.name: Prawn Güveç
services.description: King prawns baked in a traditional clay pot with tomato, pepper and herbs.

services.name: Shepherd's Salad
services.description: Crisp cucumber, tomato, green pepper, onion and parsley — always fresh.

services.name: Künefe
services.description: Warm shredded wheat pastry with soft cheese, soaked in syrup, topped with pistachios.

services.name: Raki & Meze Set
services.description: The classic Turkish ritual — chilled raki with a curated mezze selection.
